index.html.7ce4e8d8: Blockchain security and IPFS storage ensure tamper-proof, transparent voting
index.html.8bac1ac7: Cardano blockchain and IPFS decentralized storage ensure vote integrity with minimal gas fees. Native metadata transactions keep costs low for accessibility in resource-limited environments. Biometric authentication provides security without complexity.

index.html.4f1d949f: Every line of code is publicly available on GitHub under AGPL-3.0. This ensures transparency, allows global contributions, and prevents vendor lock-in. Communities can fork, modify, and adapt the platform to their specific needs while contributing back to the collective good.

index.html.d857d34b: From informal settlements in Ghana to community cooperatives worldwide, VoteBoxApp provides practical tools for collective decision-making. Low bandwidth requirements, multilingual support, and offline capabilities ensure the technology serves those who need it most.

get-the-app.html.d8bcb833: Direct democracy in your pocket. One person, one vote — no tokens, no wealth advantage, ever.
get-the-app.html.e458e4ea: Point your phone camera here to download the app straight to your device. Or tap the download button further down.
get-the-app.html.8963c4ae: Install and unlock with your fingerprint. No email, no sign-up, no personal data — a private key is generated right on your phone.
get-the-app.html.4e6654d9: Browse what your community is deciding and cast your vote. It’s written to the Cardano ledger — permanent, public, tamper-proof. Voting is always free.
get-the-app.html.6911e504: Got something your neighbourhood, group, or town should decide together? Post a proposal and let people weigh in.
get-the-app.html.cb04e73e: Send your proposal link to friends. Anyone without the app lands on a page that guides them to install it — then they vote and create proposals of their own. That’s the loop.
get-the-app.html.1ca51755: Installing on Android — a quick walkthrough
get-the-app.html.9f304aec: Because the app isn’t in the Play Store yet, your phone will show a couple of caution screens. Here’s exactly what to tap.
get-the-app.html.f63117fb: This is normal — nothing is wrong with the app. Android shows these warnings for any app installed outside the Play Store, including ones still in testing. VoteBoxApp is fully open source — every line is public on GitHub.
get-the-app.html.ffbeab9e: When this appears, don’t press OK. Instead, tap the small Install anyway text just above the button.
get-the-app.html.df9b83ad: Unsafe app blocked screen, tap Install anyway
get-the-app.html.78a26f1b: Send app for security check screen, tap Don't send
get-the-app.html.84661a40: You don’t need to send anything to Google. Just tap Don’t send and the install will finish on its own.
get-the-app.html.465baaef: The app installs, opens to the VoteBoxApp welcome screen, and asks for your fingerprint. That’s it — you’re ready to vote.

get-the-app.html.cc74e9fe: Android only for now · the two caution screens above are expected — just follow the walkthrough
